nodes.title: Generalized binomial coefficient

nodes.summary: Let $f \colon \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be a positive sequence, that is $f(i) > 0$ for every $i > 0$. Then for every natural number $n$, the generalized factorial $f(1) f(2) \cdots f(n)$ is positive.
nodes.title: Generalized factorials of positive sequences are positive

nodes.summary: For a sequence $f \colon \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and a natural number $n$, the generalized factorial of $f$ at $n$ is the product $f(1) f(2) \cdots f(n)$ of the values $f(i)$ for $1 \le i \le n$; for $n = 0$ it is the empty product $1$.
